evidence.excerpt: Tošić has provided design review consultancy to a regional electrical contracting firm on the surge protection scheme of a 480 kWp ground-mounted plant in Vojvodina. He has also conducted SPD acceptance testing for an imported product batch on behalf of a local distributor.
